message: 大丈夫
Let's give it everything we've got for the Holy Night Festival! At the same time, though, we can't take our eyes off the demons' movements either.
Helena-san might have caught wind of something about the Demon Generals, right? Let's go ask her.

name: Melilot
message: 「Heave-ho, heave-ho...」

name: Synn
message: 「Melilot-san?」
Cardboard boxes are stacked high in the Kujo residence's parking area, and Melilot-san is carrying them one by one toward the front entrance.

name: Melilot
message: 「Oh, Sakura―kun? Good aftern―」

name: Melilot
message: 「Waaah!?」
Melilot-san ends up dropping the cardboard box, sending a huge pile of potatoes rolling across the ground.

name: Melilot
message: 「Ngh, uuugh~!」

name: Synn
message: 「I'll help you pick them up」

name: Melilot
message: 「Thank you. That's a big help」
Melilot-san and I gather up the potatoes together. Even with sweat beading on my forehead, the air around the Kujo mansion feels refreshing.
It smells of rich soil and deep greenery damp with morning dew. Come to think of it, I hear there are fir trees growing in the garden.

name: Melilot
message: 「And that should do it」

name: Synn
message: 「Is this whole mountain of cardboard boxes all potatoes?」

name: Melilot
message: 「No」

name: Melilot
message: 「Eggs and chicken, cranberries and watercress, assorted fruits, and ground ginger」

name: Melilot
message: 「Over here we have shallots and spearmint, sherry and rosemary, plus canned anchovies as well」

name: Synn
message: 「H-Hmm, are these snacks to go with drinks? There's sweet stuff mixed in for that, though...」

name: Melilot
message: 「They're ingredients for Christmas dishes. Goodness, Helena is getting ahead of herself」

name: Melilot
message: 「She's surely planning to make test batches before the actual day」

name: Melilot
message: 「Heave... ho」

name: Synn
message: 「Please don't carry them all by yourself. I told you I'll help」

name: Synn
message: 「Both you and Helena-san are being way too distant. If you'd just said the word, I'd have come running right away」

name: Melilot
message: 「Sakura-kun. Despite how she may seem, Helena does not mix public and private matters」

name: Synn
message: 「Huh... But she called you over like this, didn't she?」

name: Melilot
message: 「Hehe」
Melilot-san and I hold a single cardboard box together, matching each other's breathing as we carry it slowly.

name: Melilot
message: 「Normally, we would have the staff carry these inside the mansion, but it seems they're quite busy...」

name: Synn
message: 「Ah, so that's why they're piled up like a mountain」

name: Melilot
message: 「Upsy-daisy」

name: Synn
message: 「Um... where is the all-important Helena-san?」

name: Helena
message: 「Hiii, sorry to keep you waiting, Melilot\s04 Oh, Synn-chan's here too, perfect timing」

name: Melilot
message: 「Ah... Helena, did you bring the hand truck?」

name: Helena
message: 「Ta-da! Look, look, it's my new phone♪」

name: Melilot
message: 「Never mind that, please bring the hand truck!!」

name: Synn
message: 「Y-You're completely in 'personal' mode, aren't you...」

name: Helena
message: 「Yep♪」

name: Helena
message: 「Ufufu, Melilot and Synn-chan's very first joint task, snapped!」

name: Melilot
message: 「Why are you taking pictures without asking!!」

name: Helena
message: 「Teehee, just kidding. I brought the hand truck, just like I was supposed to」

name: Helena
message: 「Honestly, Melilot, you're so impatient. You didn't have to go out of your way to carry it by hand if you'd just waited for me to get here」

name: Melilot
message: 「Gasp!?」

name: Synn
message: 「Ah... now that you mention it, that's true」

name: Helena
message: 「Aaaand--we're--doooone♪」

name: Melilot
message: 「Huff, puff, huff, puff--even using a hand truck, we still had to use sheer manpower on the front entrance stairs!」

name: Helena
message: 「Mmm, that flushed red face of yours is adorable, Melilot\s04 Let me take one picture, okay」

name: Melilot
message: 「No way!」

name: Synn
message: 「Um... it seems like I'm getting in the way, so I'll take my leave soon」

name: Helena
message: 「Aww, leaving already? Big sis is sad, you know」

name: Helena
message: 「Since we're all here, let's take a commemorative photo of the three of us.」

name: Melilot
message: 「...Helena, in that case, shouldn't we invite everyone from the Student Council too?」

name: Helena
message: 「That's a good idea. Well then, I'll go call everyone over.」
About thirty minutes later, the usual crowd gathered and we took the photo.

name: Melilot
message: 「It's alright. Everyone is here.」
A few days later, Melilot received the data from Helena and handed out printed copies of the photo for each of us while saying those words.
Everyone really is here.
I think to myself as my eyes trace over each person one by one.
Melilot and Helena, huddled shoulder to shoulder in a tight squeeze in front of the Kujou mansion.
Ria-senpai, smiling wryly after getting teased by Helena.
Misa, puffing out her cheeks and sulking because she couldn't stand next to Ria-senpai.
Lolotte, her eyes sparkling as she looks curiously at all the Christmas goods.
Nanaka, blocking Paqy from clinging onto Ria-senpai with a beaming smile.
Azel, looking away while still pressed up close against everyone.
And me.
Everyone's here, not a single person missing.
Everything's okay.
